source_device.description: The source disk device path to clone from.

target_device.description: The target disk device path to clone to.

root_partition_num.description: The partition number on the source drive that is mounted as the root filesystem (/).

efi_partition_num.description: The partition number on the source drive that is the EFI System Partition. Use 0 if not applicable.

boot_partition_num.description: The partition number on the source drive that is mounted as /boot. Use 0 if not applicable.

bootloader_plugin.description: The bootloader plugin to use for installing the bootloader on the target (e.g., grub2, uuid_copy, syslinux).

check_and_partition.description: If true, check if target partitions are valid and re-partition/re-format them if necessary.

excluded_partitions.description: A list of partition numbers to exclude from being copied or searched. Items are integers representing partition numbers.

rsync_args.description: Arguments to pass to the rsync command used for file copying.

lvm_source_vg.description: The name of the LVM source Volume Group to clone. Empty string if no LVM cloning is required.

lvm_target_vg.description: The name of the LVM target Volume Group. Empty string uses {source}-copy.

verbose.description: If true, enable verbose output from wereSync.

debug.description: If true, enable debug output from wereSync.

source_partition_mask.description: A format string to construct source partition paths, taking device name and partition number as arguments.

target_partition_mask.description: A format string to construct target partition paths, taking device name and partition number as arguments.

source_mount_dir.description: The directory to mount source partitions. Empty string uses a random /tmp directory.

target_mount_dir.description: The directory to mount target partitions. Empty string uses a random /tmp directory.

break_on_error.description: If true, halt the program if any errors occur during copying.
